title: GCD and LCM Calculator
seoTitle: GCD and LCM Calculator — Free Online
description: Find the greatest common divisor and least common multiple of two or more integers. Euclidean steps stay in the browser. Nothing is uploaded.
intro: Paste a list of integers and get the GCD, LCM and a short Euclidean trace for the first pair. Useful for fractions, schedules and ratios.
blurb: Calculate GCD and LCM for any list of integers locally.
howItWorks: Enter two or more integers separated by commas, spaces or new lines.
Press Calculate. GCD uses the Euclidean algorithm; LCM uses GCD so products do not overflow early.
Read the shared divisor, the common multiple and the step trace.
examples: Coprime inputs such as 7 and 13 have GCD 1.

faq.q: Can I use more than two numbers?
faq.a: Yes. The calculator folds GCD and LCM across the whole list, ignoring order.
Signs are ignored. A list of only zeros has GCD 0 and no finite LCM, which is reported.
No. The arithmetic runs entirely in the page.
